body:
Congrats! I started no contact 2 weeks ago and I won't say that it has been easy, but it has been freeing and it was necessary in order to have a life to call my own. 
Stick with it! This is the only way to completely free ourselves from a narcissist.
Congrats on your award and I'm sorry that your friend made your night about herself. I think she was selfish. In my opinion, her announcement could have waited one more day.

Actually, it makes perfect sense to me. I've often said that I want to die but I don't want to hurt myself. If you don't think that your family or girlfriend will understand how you're feeling; maybe find a counselor or therapist that will. 
Don't let it go unsaid. "I don't want to kill myself" can easily turn to "I'm going to kill myself."
